title: Zuri and the Sunny Drink Warmer
markdown:
One bright morning, Zuri and her robot friend, Bloop, hurried to the Sunny Meadow Fair. Suddenly, they heard a sad sound. It was Coach Ellis, the snack vendor. His pretzel warmer was empty, and his water was cool. "The fair-goers will expect warm drinks!" he sighed.

Zuri, her clever mind always whirring, looked at the bright sky. She remembered how Bloop’s solar charger got warm in the sun. "What if," she thought, "we used the sun's own warmth?" She found a stout magnifying glass. When she held it just right, a bright beam of light hit a dry leaf. Snap! The leaf curled, turned brown, and a tiny puff of smoke rose. "Look!" she cried. "This glass makes the sunbeams super strong and hot!"

"Coach Ellis!" Zuri called, her smile as bright as the sun. "We can use the sun's power!"

With Bloop helping, Zuri explained. Coach Ellis found shiny foil and mirrors. Zuri arranged them to catch the sunlight and aim it at the dark pot of water. Then, she used the magnifying glass to focus a super-strong sunbeam onto the pot.

The water soaked up the sun's strong rays. Soon, it was steaming, ready for Coach Ellis's drinks!

Coach Ellis cheered. "You warmed the water with sunshine!"

Zuri smiled. "The sun's energy is strong," she said. "When we focus many sunbeams, they make heat. It's called solar energy! The sun gave the water a warm hug!" Bloop showed a picture of the sunbeams focusing on the pot.

The Wise Owl hooted softly, "The generous sun offers its warmth freely. Those with open eyes, like Zuri and Bloop, find its gifts everywhere. What other sunlit secrets are waiting, dear fledglings?"
characters: Zuri the careful coder, Bloop the robot, Coach Ellis
